```python
# Test cases for parse_qsl_

# Basic functionality
assert parse_qsl_("a=1&b=2") == [('a', '1'), ('b', '2')], (parse_qsl_("a=1&b=2"), [('a', '1'), ('b', '2')])
assert parse_qsl_("a=1&b=2&c=3") == [('a', '1'), ('b', '2'), ('c', '3')], (parse_qsl_("a=1&b=2&c=3"), [('a', '1'), ('b', '2'), ('c', '3')])

# Handling '+' as space
assert parse_qsl_("name=John+Doe") == [('name', 'John Doe')], (parse_qsl_("name=John+Doe"), [('name', 'John Doe')])
assert parse_qsl_("a+b=c+d") == [('a b', 'c d')], (parse_qsl_("a+b=c+d"), [('a b', 'c d')])

# Handling percent-escapes
assert parse_qsl_("msg=Hello%20World") == [('msg', 'Hello World')], (parse_qsl_("msg=Hello%20World"), [('msg', 'Hello World')])
assert parse_qsl_("path=%2Fusr%2Fbin") == [('path', '/usr/bin')], (parse_qsl_("path=%2Fusr%2Fbin"), [('path', '/usr/bin')])
assert parse_qsl_("special=%E2%9C%93") == [('special', '✓')], (parse_qsl_("special=%E2%9C%93"), [('special', '✓')])

# Handling components with no '='
assert parse_qsl_("a=1&b&c=3", keep_blank_values=True) == [('a', '1'), ('b', ''), ('c', '3')], (parse_qsl_("a=1&b&c=3", keep_blank_values=True), [('a', '1'), ('b', ''), ('c', '3')])
assert parse_qsl_("a=1&b&c=3", keep_blank_values=False) == [('a', '1'), ('c', '3')], (parse_qsl_("a=1&b&c=3", keep_blank_values=False), [('a', '1'), ('c', '3')])

# Handling empty values (key=)
assert parse_qsl_("a=&b=2", keep_blank_values=True) == [('a', ''), ('b', '2')], (parse_qsl_("a=&b=2", keep_blank_values=True), [('a', ''), ('b', '2')])
assert parse_qsl_("a=&b=2", keep_blank_values=False) == [('b', '2')], (parse_qsl_("a=&b=2", keep_blank_values=False), [('b', '2')])

# Handling empty input and multiple separators
assert parse_qsl_("") == [], (parse_qsl_(""), [])
assert parse_qsl_("&&a=1&&") == [('a', '1')], (parse_qsl_("&&a=1&&"), [('a', '1')])

# Handling multiple '=' in one component (only first should split)
assert parse_qsl_("a=b=c") == [('a', 'b=c')], (parse_qsl_("a=b=c"), [('a', 'b=c')])

# Verifying ';' is NOT treated as a separator
assert parse_qsl_("a=1;b=2") == [('a', '1;b=2')], (parse_qsl_("a=1;b=2"), [('a', '1;b=2')])
```
